terms.title: Terms of use
items: Yororis is a short chat with an AI neighbour. It is not a health service, not an emergency service and not a person. In a crisis in Canada, call or text 9-8-8; in Québec, call 811 (Info-Social).
This space is open to invited testers who are 18 or older. Nobody can create an account here.
What you say is forgotten when the moment ends: no transcript, nothing taken away.
We hold your e-mail, your first name, your language, your picture and the date you agreed, only to let you in.
You can delete your account at once from the account page: everything about you goes with it.
